<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2012/06/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>HeatonLife.Core</id>
    <version>1.0.0</version>
    <authors>Jeff Heaton</authors>
    <license type="expression">Apache-2.0</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/Apache-2.0</licenseUrl>
    <icon>heaton_life_icon.png</icon>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/jeffheaton/heaton-life</projectUrl>
    <description>Explore emergence in .NET: cellular automata (MergeLife, Life-like, Elementary, Cyclic, Wireworld), three flavors of Lenia, escape-time fractals with deep zoom (Mandelbrot, Julia, Burning Ship, Newton), Reynolds boids, and Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion under one consistent API, plus a genetic evolver that searches for new MergeLife rules. Pure C#, netstandard2.1, zero dependencies: it runs anywhere .NET does, including Unity and IL2CPP, and its step and frame APIs allocate nothing. Every system follows a written specification and conformance vectors shared with the Python package, so the same parameters and seed give the same run in either language.</description>
    <tags>cellular-automata lenia fractals boids reaction-diffusion mergelife emergence artificial-life</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/jeffheaton/heaton-life" commit="234075b9097f2ce32e3d508d1ff9fce9303214d1" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework=".NETStandard2.1" />
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
